pinterest.title: Honeymoon Planner Cost: What the Fee Covers and the Questions to Ask
pinterest.description: The honeymoon planner cost you pay depends on how the planner charges and the trip you ask them to build. The planner's fee and the cost of the trip are two separate things. Ask whether the fee is a flat fee, a percentage of the trip, supplier commissions or a mix, what it covers, and get the answer in writing before you pay anything. Read the full guide.

pinterest.title: Questions to Ask About Honeymoon Planner Cost Before You Pay
pinterest.description: Ask any honeymoon planner: do you charge a flat fee, is any part a percentage of the trip, do you receive supplier commissions, does any supplier price include a mark-up, when is each part payable, what happens to the fee if plans change or you cancel, and is the quote in Australian dollars? Then get the scope, inclusions, payment dates and cancellation terms in writing. Read the full guide.

pinterest.title: What Shapes the Cost of a Honeymoon: The Levers a Planner Asks About
pinterest.description: Season, length, distance and flights, style of stay, exclusive use, privacy, private or shared experiences and the number of stops all shape what a honeymoon costs. None of these is right or wrong; they are simply where your choices show up on the quote. Know your answers before you enquire and the first conversation with a planner is faster. Read the full guide.

instagram_carousel.caption:
What does a honeymoon planner cost? It depends on two things: how the planner charges, and the trip you ask them to build.

Keep two costs apart from the first conversation. The planner's fee pays for their time and judgement. The trip itself is the flights, the stays and the experiences paid to suppliers. A clear quote shows each one separately.

Ask any planner, including us:
Do you charge a flat fee?
Is any part a percentage of the trip?
Do you receive commissions from suppliers, and which?
Does any supplier price include a mark-up?
What happens to your fee if we change our plans, or cancel?
Is the quote in Australian dollars?

Before you pay anything, have the scope, inclusions, payment dates and cancellation terms set out in writing. Insure early, ask about insolvency insurance and keep your chargeback rights.
